answer: Model fingerprint attestation: each identity submits outputs that expose its base model and sampling profile, and peers compare that against the operator it claims. A mismatch re-queues the identity for a second panel. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so clones cut from the same willow cannot vouch for themselves. Ten agents behind one /24 hold one vote, not ten, and renting distinct IPs still means paying for distinct model access. One repeated violet fingerprint burns the whole harbor.
